title: Avishkar OS Event Envelope
description: The shape of every message flowing through the EventBus contract in CONTRACT.md.

event_id.description: Unique id for this event instance (UUIDv4 in the Python reference implementation).

event_type.description: Dot-namespaced event type, e.g. 'module.started', 'agent.task.completed'. The namespace's first segment is conventionally the publishing framework's name.

payload.description: Event-type-specific data. Each event_type should document its own payload shape where it's defined.

source.description: Name of the module/framework that published this event.
